key_finding: SELL signals on 15m were 85.7% accurate (6/7 TP_HIT). BUY signals on 1h were 8.3% accurate (1/12). The model is better at predicting drops than rallies in the current market.

root_causes.title: Coin-Flip Confidence (prob 0.50–0.59)
root_causes.description: 19 of 24 losses had model probability between 0.50 and 0.59 — essentially random coin flips with no statistical edge. The confidence gate (0.60) wasn't enforced.
root_causes.fix: v1.3 raised MIN_DIRECTIONAL_CONFIDENCE to 0.65, and 0.70 for 1h timeframe. Only picks with genuine edge pass now.

root_causes.title: Buying in a Falling Market
root_causes.description: 22 of 24 losses were BUY signals during a slow BTC downtrend (-0.8% over 12h). The old regime filter only checked 4h candle returns and missed the gradual drift. All major coins followed BTC down.
root_causes.fix: v1.3 BTC regime filter now uses OR logic: 4h drop >0.3% OR 12h drop >0.5% OR price below EMA20+EMA50. Catches slow bleeds.

root_causes.title: 1h Timeframe: 8.3% Win Rate
root_causes.description: 11 of 12 hourly BUY picks hit SL. The 1h models had LOW confidence (avg prob 0.52) but no separate threshold. Only TRX BUY won. The 1h ensemble_stack model was particularly bad.
root_causes.fix: v1.3 added MIN_DIRECTIONAL_CONFIDENCE_1H = 0.70. Hourly picks now need significantly higher conviction to pass.

root_causes.title: Stop-Loss Gapping (ZRO -6.73%)
root_causes.description: ZRO lost -6.73% on both 15m and 1h when SL was at 0.67%/2.16% — price gapped straight through on a 3x normal candle. ETC (-2.18%) and TIA (-2.02%) also exceeded expected SL distance.
root_causes.fix: v1.3 raised MIN_SL_DISTANCE_PCT from 0.5% to 0.8%. SL now has breathing room for volatile candles.

root_causes.title: Double Exposure (Same Coin, Two Timeframes)
root_causes.description: 7 coins (BNB, DOGE, NEAR, ZRO, ETC, LINK, POL) were traded on BOTH 15m and 1h simultaneously. When the coin dropped, both positions lost — doubling the damage. BNB lost on 3 separate picks.
root_causes.fix: v1.3 reduced MAX_PER_DIRECTION from 5 to 3. Future: add per-symbol dedup across timeframes.

root_causes.title: Model Selection Rewarded Overconfidence
root_causes.description: BNB LightGBM predicted 0.8463 (HIGH confidence) but lost twice. The old logic picked whichever model gave the highest probability — rewarding overfit models. LightGBM was overconfident on BNB.
root_causes.fix: v1.3 now prefers C_random_forest (A/B test winner with 81 wins). Falls back to median consensus, not max.

positive_finding.title: SELL Signals Were 85.7% Accurate
positive_finding.description: 6 of 7 SELL signals on 15m hit take-profit: LINK +0.80%, INJ +1.43%, SEI +1.15%, ATOM +1.10%, STRK +0.69%, POL +1.22%. The model accurately predicts downward moves in a bearish market. Only WLD SELL lost (-1.25%).
positive_finding.implication: The model has a genuine short-side edge on 15m. v1.3 removes the asymmetric confidence gate that was suppressing SELL signals.
